readme:
# Tori.fi Scraper

Scrape classified listings from [Tori.fi](https://www.tori.fi), Finland's largest online marketplace (Schibsted group).

## How it works

1. Go to [tori.fi](https://www.tori.fi) and search for what you need
2. Copy the search URL or just enter a keyword
3. Paste it into the actor input
4. Run the actor

The actor extracts all listings matching your search, with automatic pagination.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/tori-fi-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `tori-fi-scraper` to scrape company data from tori fi. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Output

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `title` | Listing title |
| `price` / `currency` | Price in EUR |
| `location` | City, area, or region |
| `brand` | Brand name |
| `condition` | Item condition |
| `seller` | Seller name |
| `image_url` / `image_urls` | Images |
| `posted_at` | Publication date |
| `source_url` | Link to listing on Tori.fi |

## Pricing

No start fee -- pay only for results:

| Event | Cost |
|-------|------|
| Listing (basic) | $0.003 |
| Listing (with details) | $0.005 |

**100 listings = $0.30** (basic) or **$0.50** (with details)

## Examples

### Search by keyword
```json
{
  "searchQuery": "polkupyora",
  "maxResults": 50,
  "includeDetails": true
}
```

### Multiple searches in one run
```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["iphone", "samsung galaxy", "macbook"],
  "maxResults": 100,
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 50
}
```

### Quick SERP-only scan
```json
{
  "searchQuery": "iphone",
  "maxResults": 200,
  "includeDetails": false
}
```
